reasoning: On the season so far the Clippers are the stronger team; with home court the Clippers start about 8 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets (look-ahead, confidence).
Bottom line: the Clippers win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 189 and 238 total points.

analyst.text: The Clippers are gaining confidence after a 113-112 win over Oklahoma City, their second in three games after a seven-game skid. The franchise is still under league penalties, and Brandon Ingram and Bradley Beal have yet to debut. Charlotte are 1-4 on the road and committed 27 turnovers in a loss at Phoenix. They are also without Brandon Miller, Dennis Schroder and Kon Knueppel. The angle leans slightly towards the Clippers.
